thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate from inference tier in us-west-2 — 503s from GPU-backed pools. Auto-remediation attempted (scale-up) but errors persisted. Pager sent to @maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming impact: hitting ~12% 5m error rate for hosted/text-generation routes. Tracing shows queue starved on gpu-pool-usw2-1.

raj (eng-platform): thx maya. Can you run `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-usw2 -o wide` and paste output? also check autoscaler events: `kubectl describe hpa gpu-pool-usw2`

maya (oncall): pasted outputs below. pods are in CrashLoopBackOff for 3 nodes, OOMKilled logs show nvml allocation failures. HPA shows no new replicas created due to insufficient quota in region.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigation attempt: bumped routing weight to eu-central for high-priority tenant routes via `routectl swap-weight --from=us-west-2 --to=eu-central --routes=org:priority` — started diffused traffic.

alin (sre): good. Start failover runbook step 2: enable cross-region fallback for all public routes and notify support. I'm also triggering a manual scale request to Dedicated overflow (if capacity) `infractl reserve --pool=dedicated-overflow --region=us-west-2 --gpus=8`

kim (support): reached out to top 5 customers impacted, initial message: "We are aware of transient errors in us-west inference; traffic is being routed to alternate regions; we will follow up with root cause and ETA." customers asked for ETA, told ~30–60m for traffic stabilization. :phone:

raj (eng-platform): update: dedicated-overflow request failed due to global quota. No spare capacity. I'm starting soft-preemption on lower-priority jobs in us-west to reclaim 12 GPUs — `scheduler preempt --label=best-effort --region=us-west-2 --gpus=12`

maya (oncall): preempt started. Seeing reclaim events and pods coming up. Error rate falling from 12% -> 2% in 10m.

incident-bot: Paging note: @maya -> @raj (eng-platform) for follow-up during next shift. Handoff timestamped.

maya (oncall): handing off to raj for longer-term remediation and postmortem. I'll remain available for questions.

raj (eng-platform): taking over. Immediate priorities: 1) confirm reclaimed GPUs stable; 2) disable risky autoscaler thresholds that prevented scale-up; 3) schedule postmortem and action items.

alin (sre): quick logs: saw nvml allocation spikes traced to a memory-leak regression in our cuda allocator binary introduced in last runtime patch (runt-2.14.0). Repro locally on small scale.

jess (product): any customer-visible SLA impact? we need exact windows for comms and billing credits considerations.

maya (oncall): preliminary impact window: 1776017700 -> 1776020400 (about 45m) when errors rose then stabilized after routing/preempt. Will confirm with metrics dashboard.

kim (support): compiling list of customers who hit >5% errors. Will post table here in 20m.

raj (eng-platform): creating ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4921 (placeholder) — title: "us-west-2 GPU shortage + autoscaler threshold regression". Assigning to @raj, @alin. Linking support list.

raj (eng-platform): action items I'm tracking now: 1) rollback runt-2.14.0 or hotfix allocator (owner: alin, due: 48h) 2) autoscaler rule change to allow emergency scale beyond quota guard for 30m windows (owner: raj, due: 24h) 3) improve cross-region failover docs/runbook (owner: maya, due: 72h) 4) customer comms + SLA assessment (owner: kim/jess, due: 24h)

alin (sre): I'll prepare a hotfix branch and smoke test on staging. If hotfix isn't safe within 24h we schedule immediate rollback to runt-2.13.x.

maya (oncall): runbook nit: add explicit step to call out preemption as a viable mitigation earlier in flow; current doc favors scale-up only. I'll open PR to runbook repo.

raj (eng-platform): noted. Also we need a postmortem meeting: propose tomorrow 15:00 UTC. attendants: eng-platform, SRE, oncall rotation, product, support. kim can you confirm customer-facing message after we have root cause + ETA?

kim (support): confirm I'll draft and send templated follow-up after we finalize impact list and credit calculation.

jess (product): will prepare internal impact slide for execs and summary for customers. Need finalized window and affected customers list.

maya (oncall): logging final mitigation summary here: - preemption reclaimed 12 GPUs - routing weight shift to eu-central for priority routes - autoscaler temporarily relaxed via manual override - error rate reduced to baseline in ~40m

incident-bot: Post-incident: scheduled postmortem meeting created in calendar for 1776104200 (tomorrow 15:00 UTC). Reminder to assign remediation tasks to Jira and link here.

raj (eng-platform): I updated INF-4921 with action list and sub-tasks: INF-4922 (hotfix), INF-4923 (autoscaler policy), INF-4924 (runbook PR), INF-4925 (customer comms). Adding owners and due dates.

alin (sre): initial hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/runt/PR-231 (testing). If CI green, plan deploy to canary tonight.

maya (oncall): I'm closing the active pager — handoff complete. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes and remediation tracking.

raj (eng-platform): summary of agreed remediation owners/dates (copying to thread): - hotfix allocator (alin) — 48h - autoscaler emergency rule (raj) — 24h - runbook update (maya) — 72h - customer impact + credits (kim/jess) — 24h

kim (support): posted affected customer CSV here: (redacted) — will follow up with bespoke messages for enterprise customers.

jess (product): confirm attending postmortem. will bring customer impact slide.

raj (eng-platform): closing notes: add metrics alert to detect nvml allocation failure pattern and create synthetic test that exercises preemption path weekly. Owner: raj, due: 7 days.

maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: Thanks all. If anything major re-escalates ping this thread and page oncall.

alin (sre): will post postmortem draft after meeting and link PRs/timestamps.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Severity: Sev2. Duration: ~45m. Follow-ups scheduled.
